blockingFindings.title: Tracked diff identity is tested with an untracked file
blockingFindings.rationale: R10 has no spec-local regression that specifically exercises tracked uncommitted diff bytes; the current test can validate a different implementation premise.
blockingFindings.issue: The review identity assertion writes `src/demo.js` inside the fixture and compares `resolveCurrentReviewTreeSha` before/after, but the test never establishes that `src/demo.js` is a tracked file in that fixture. This can pass by hashing newly created or untracked bytes, while R10 specifically requires tracked uncommitted diff bytes to affect review identity.
blockingFindings.requiredChange: Change this scenario to modify a fixture file that is already tracked, or explicitly stage/track the file before the baseline and then mutate it before the after hash comparison.
blockingFindings.whyBlocking: R10 has no spec-local regression that specifically exercises tracked uncommitted diff bytes; the current test can validate a different implementation premise.
